Ram Temple Trust Faces Scrutiny Over Donations Amid Theft Allegations

The Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust is facing scrutiny following allegations of donation theft. The Supreme Court has urged parties not to politicize the matter and has suggested the Uttar Pradesh government consider a Special Investigation Team (SIT) probe. The Nirmohi Akhara has filed a petition in the Supreme Court seeking the reconstitution of the trust as a public trust, aligning with the 2019 title dispute judgment. Meanwhile, the State Bank of India (SBI) has taken over the counting of temple donations under a new system.
